name: pluto
description: Use TalentPluto's live recruiting workflows, privacy-filtered candidate discovery, bulk candidate work-email enrichment, small lookup of LinkedIn profiles, medium lookup with derived employment-company intelligence, heavy lookup adding cited public-web findings, client-shared candidate rubric creation and full-replacement editing with per-company preferences and priorities, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, separate 0-100 candidate scoring against Team DNA, a supplied job description, or a loaded saved rubric when the server supplies a policy-approved professional scoring projection, outbound campaigns using an authorized Gmail inbox belonging to the requester or a coworker, or Pluto-managed delivery, explicitly directed Ashby candidate creation, bounded candidate-field updates, native PDF resume uploads, active-job choice resolution, public top-level notes, job consideration, and application-stage changes for up to 50 candidates per action through TalentPluto's stored Ashby connection, and privacy-thresholded market snapshots through a stable, authenticated Pluto connection.

interface.shortDescription: Use TalentPluto recruiting, rubric, outbound, and market tools.
interface.longDescription: Connect once to use TalentPluto's live recruiting, candidate-email enrichment, LinkedIn profile enrichment, deep candidate enrichment with derived employment-company intelligence, full candidate enrichment adding cited public-web findings, client-shared candidate rubric creation and full-replacement editing with preferred and avoided company priorities, candidate-to-Team DNA comparison, separate 0-100 candidate scoring against Team DNA, a supplied job description, or a loaded saved rubric when the server supplies a policy-approved professional scoring projection, reviewable outbound campaigns using an authorized Gmail inbox belonging to the requester or a coworker, or Pluto-managed delivery, confirmed campaign cancellation, explicitly directed candidate creation, bounded candidate-field updates, native PDF resume uploads, public notes, job consideration, and application-stage changes for up to 50 candidates per action through TalentPluto's stored Ashby connection, and market-insight workflows in Codex. Pluto advertises its current tools and input contracts from its MCP server, and clear campaign creation and Ashby write requests execute without redundant confirmation turns while durable batches are polled automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use Pluto to help with this recruiting task.
Find AI engineers with 1+ years of professional experience in New York.
Find people who match this pasted job description.
Give me a directional US market snapshot for engineering talent.
How many Pluto credits do I have left, and when do they reset?
Ask whether the selected in-network candidate's recorded preference is compatible with a $180,000 annual base salary.
Get and verify the available emails for the candidates I selected.
Get the full public profiles for the LinkedIn profile URLs I supplied.
Deep-enrich the LinkedIn profiles I selected with professional profiles and derived employment-company intelligence.
How does the background of the candidate I supplied overlap with our Team DNA?
Create or edit a candidate scoring rubric with preferred and avoided companies at high, medium, or low priority, show the complete proposed contents, and save only after I confirm the exact proposal.
Score the candidate I selected against our Team DNA, this job description, or one of my saved rubrics.
Source candidates from this job description and add the ones I pick to my Ashby job.
Update this existing Ashby candidate's explicitly supplied professional fields without asking me to confirm again when the prepared review matches.
Upload this attached PDF resume to the exact existing Ashby candidate I identify, when the attachment is available to the tool as a short-lived public HTTPS URL.

Create a campaign for the candidates I selected. Prepare any missing recipient emails, ask once whether I want a saved template or custom content if needed, then create it without asking me to repeat or reconfirm this request.
Cancel my outbound campaign for the payments role.
Continue with the candidate and role I selected in Pluto.
